subject: Executive access windows and delegate coverage for CTO sponsor demo
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@acmeplatform.com>, Michael Liu <michael.liu@acmeplatform.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Executive access windows and delegate coverage for CTO sponsor demo

Hi Asha / Michael —

Thanks again for taking this forward with your team. We’d like to schedule a 30–45 minute sponsor-level demo to show the integration path and performance economics for Acme’s primary workloads. To make scheduling easier across teams, can you confirm which of these windows works best for the CTO / CIO / VP attendance?

Proposed windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue 14 Sep, 10:00–10:45 PT (preferred for product deep-dive)
- Option B: Tue 14 Sep, 15:30–16:15 PT (preferred for exec availability)

If neither works, please suggest two 30–45 minute windows next week. Also: who else from your side will join (CTO + 1 PM ideal) and whether we should expect the CTO for the full time or a 15-minute cameo.

Attached: exec_demo_agenda.pdf and a calendar invite (redwood_calendar_v2.ics). I’ve also included a one-pager on security/compliance you can share with procurement if helpful.

Agenda (high level):
- 5 min intro / objectives
- 20 min demo (throughput, latency, cost tradeoffs)
- 10 min deployment options + rollout plan
- 5–10 min next steps / mutual action plan

If the CTO needs a short pre-brief, we can do a 15-minute call the morning of the demo. Happy to be flexible — let me know.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: exec_demo_agenda.pdf, redwood_calendar_v2.ics, security_one_pager.pdf

From: Asha Reddy <asha@acmeplatform.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Liu <michael.liu@acmeplatform.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive access windows and delegate coverage for CTO sponsor demo

Thanks Rishi — really appreciate the clear options. Quick notes:

- Michael (CTO) can attend but will be tied up in a customer briefing at 10:00 PT. Can we move to Option B and shift slightly to 15:30 PT (same day)? That gives him a clean handoff.
- I’ll bring our Head of AI Product (Priya Shah) and Michael will try to stay for the first 25 min and then join for Q&A.
- A short 15-minute pre-brief with Michael the morning of Tue 14 is doable if you can do 8:45–9:00 PT.

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply, Asha. 15:30 PT on Tue 14 Sep works for us. I’ve updated the calendar invite to Tue 14 Sep, 15:30–16:15 PT and attached the revised .ics. Please confirm that the time shows correctly on your calendar (attendees in different timezones sometimes see an offset).

Per Asha’s note: Michael will aim for the first 25 minutes; Marissa will open and cover the initial context and deployment runbook. We’ll block 8:45–9:00 PT for the pre-brief with Michael — Karthik, could you join that call to run through the numbers and risks?

Next steps / mutual action items:
- Rishi: attach final agenda + slides to Drive by Monday EOD (attached).
- Karthik: drop throughput/export numbers in Drive (see related_links).
- Asha: confirm attendee list (Priya Shah + any additional PMs)

Updated attachments: exec_demo_agenda.pdf (v2), redwood_calendar_v2.ics

Link to updated folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExecBrief

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Rishi
